study_identification_part.si_4_title: Effects of anterior temporal lobe resection on cortical morphology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: NKI controls (833) plus site-specific NHNN/Chalfont data (91 controls; 101 TLE patients) used in this study; site-specific data treated as single-site.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We also used MR images of crosssectional cohorts of 924 healthy controls, 91 of which were taken together with patients... The remaining 833 controls are subjects from the Nathan Kline Institute (NKI) data set"; "We used 3T T1-weighted structural magnetic resonance images (MRIs) of 101 individuals with TLE who underwent ATLR at the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN)."

answer.SINGLE-SITE: site-specific controls for protocol-matched correction and TLE patient cohort for pre/post surgical analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Controls (924 total; 833 NKI and 91 site-specific) trained the normative model and informed protocol-specific effects; 101 TLE patients provided pre/post surgical data.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A normative model trained on data from 924 healthy controls was used to debias the data"; "We used the controls to provide a normative model of age and sex with scanning protocol as a random effect... The site-specific controls matching the patients then informed effects for the specific scanning protocols."; "We used 3T T1-weighted structural magnetic resonance images (MRIs) of 101 individuals with TLE who underwent ATLR"
